purpose: Primary-source feasibility research for later context data gaps; no data or features from this roadmap enter v2 or the current separately declared incremental experiment.

current_experiment.inputs: Existing adjusted ETF prices only; all frames truncated strictly before 2024-01-01 before transformations.
current_experiment.interpretation: Price spreads and correlations are economic proxies. They are not direct yields, inflation expectations, commodity carry or sector earnings revisions.

recommended_acquisition_order: ALFRED series-specific vintage audit and a release-dated H.15 rates pilot
Direct nominal/real Treasury curve archive with publication/version qualification
A vintage-aware monthly growth/inflation library from ALFRED or Philadelphia Fed RTDSM
SEC filing-based realized earnings breadth on an explicitly historical holdings universe
Licensed contract-level commodity settlement curves if actual carry is a required hypothesis

source_options.status: Public historical vintages are supported; individual series coverage and timestamp qualification remain to be audited.
source_options.verified_capability: The observations API supports historical real-time periods and vintage_dates. Output type 4 supplies initial releases; types 1 and 3 can represent revision events. Vintage-date coverage is series-specific.
source_options.access_requirements: The documented API requires a registered API key. No key was searched for, account created or API session opened here; public manual ALFRED downloads are an alternative to inspect.
source_options.availability_contract: Join observations and revisions by their vintage/realtime availability, not their economic observation date. Date-only vintages do not establish intraday receipt; use a declared conservative next-session rule or verify the original release clock. Never silently default realtime_start/end to today's vintage.
qualification_steps: Enumerate each candidate's vintage dates and earliest actual vintage coverage.
Archive raw initial/revised values, real-time validity intervals, source notes and hashes.
Compare a sample of pre-2024 vintages against original releases, including crises and holidays.
Test as-of reconstruction with corrections, sparse vintages and release-day boundaries.
Add a finite new experiment only after coverage and release availability pass review.
source_options.would_replace: The current latest-vintage, lagged FRED diagnostic archive; this is a new adapter and cannot retroactively qualify that archive.

source_options.status: Promising public release-aware route; dated original release examples verified, full archive coverage not acquired.
source_options.verified_capability: Dated historical releases contain the rates presented on that release date, while the current daily publication is at 4:15 p.m. ET on business days. The January 5, 2009 archived release instead specifies use at 2:30 p.m. ET.
source_options.critical_trap: Do not backcast today's release clock into earlier history, or confuse the rate observation date with the date it appeared in a release. Historical pages can include newly backfilled observations.
source_options.availability_contract: Store release URL/date, the release's own clock if stated, observation dates, raw document hash and a conservative first eligible decision. Preserve later corrections as new versions.
qualification_steps: Enumerate dated release URLs and verify representative 2008-2023 coverage.
Parse nominal and inflation-indexed Treasury maturities plus cash-rate fields from each original release.
Record schedule changes, discontinued fields and correction notices.
Use dated release snapshots rather than the current all-observations download as a vintage substitute.
source_options.operational_note: The Federal Reserve announces retirement work on its Data Download Program; prefer stable dated release documents or documented successor XML/FRED routes over a new dependence on its legacy package builder.

source_options.status: Public CSV/XML historical curves exist; the currently downloadable historical archive alone is not a full vintage proof.
source_options.verified_coverage: Official archive lists nominal par curves from 1990 and real par curves from 2003. Treasury says it began publishing the real-curve series on January 2, 2004, with one year of historical data.
source_options.critical_trap: The available 2003 real-yield observations were backfilled at initial 2004 publication and cannot be assumed known throughout 2003. Market quote time near 3:30 p.m. ET is not publication time; the current website usually publishes by 6 p.m. ET, with possible delays.
source_options.availability_contract: Require original publication or a verified historical vintage; preserve dated methodology changes and later corrections. A conservative lag on the current archive is only approximate PIT until this is done.
qualification_steps: Cross-check Treasury historical values against dated H.15 or ALFRED vintage snapshots.
Record maturity availability and publication start dates separately from observation start dates.
Register nominal/real level, slope and change features only after source and vintage review.
source_options.would_improve: Direct real-yield/curve context for GLD, IEF, TLT, TIP and VNQ instead of treating ETF price-return differences as yields.

source_options.status: Public vintage spreadsheets provide a credible lower-frequency macro route; not yet joined or enabled.
source_options.verified_capability: RTDSM provides macroeconomic snapshots across vintages. Real GDP has monthly/quarterly vintage histories and first/second/third release tables; archive coverage varies by variable.
source_options.availability_contract: Use the documented vintage information set. Quarterly or mid-month snapshots are not exact daily release timestamps; do not infer that all period values were available at period end. Preserve errata and vintage-specific histories.
qualification_steps: Inspect each variable's vintage schedule and source-specific documentation.
Freeze raw workbooks and parse date headers and missing values reproducibly.
Use only the most recent qualified vintage available before each decision; transformations must be recalculated within that vintage.
Keep growth/inflation experiments separate from the currently fitted price-context experiment.
source_options.research_reference: Croushore and Stark, A Real-Time Data Set for Macroeconomists, Philadelphia Fed WP 99-04; this documents vintage-data motivation and construction, not ETF trading profitability.

source_options.status: Public components exist, but a correctly vintaged historical cohort requires substantial reconstruction; not plug-and-play sector earnings revisions.
source_options.verified_capability: SEC APIs expose submissions and XBRL facts without an API key. XBRL was first required in 2009. Public N-PORT bulk files are listed from October 2019; filing detail pages expose period, filing and acceptance dates.
critical_traps: The frames API chooses a last-filed fact; it is not an as-of historical earnings panel.
A companyfacts endpoint aggregates filings and corrections; select accession-specific facts by actual dissemination/acceptance before a decision.
Quarter or holdings period-end is not the public availability date.
Present ETF constituents or current sector classifications cannot be backfilled into earlier years.
Public financial statements provide realized accounting earnings; historical analyst EPS estimate revisions need a separate entitled, vintaged source.
source_options.availability_contract: Join historical fund series/holdings to securities as disclosed at that time, then use only accession-specific facts actually public by the decision. Retain amendments, reporting units, fiscal-period alignment and sector-map effective dates. Restrict coverage to qualified years rather than pretending to cover 2008 onward.
qualification_steps: Map the actual ETF series IDs and historical public holdings filings.
Build a public-at-time holdings membership panel including delisted/removed companies.
Reconstruct earnings facts by accession and acceptance timestamp; resolve quarter/YTD and currency/unit differences.
Declare realized earnings breadth separately from analyst-estimate revision breadth and audit both coverage and publication lag.

source_options.status: Official contract-level historical settlement products exist; comprehensive historical extraction may require ordering/licensing. No purchase, login, data request or futures-system access occurred.
source_options.verified_capability: CME DataMine offers historical settlements. Current free website settlement publication is delayed until midnight Central Time; earlier distribution uses specific platforms or licenses.
source_options.critical_trap: An ETF adjusted-price return, a back-adjusted continuous futures series, or an energy/materials equity spread is not a direct observation of carry. Current settlement access rules cannot establish historical publication timing.
required_fields: settlement publication/receipt time and correction version
source_options.availability_contract: Choose near/far contracts using a fixed prior rule and only settlements disseminated before the decision. Store both contract prices and tenor. If carry is log(F_near/F_far)/tenor_difference, document day-count/sign conventions and expiration/roll handling before fitting.
qualification_steps: Determine licensing and actual historical contract coverage for the DBC-relevant markets.
Audit contract identifiers, expiry dates, corrections and release clocks.
Do not replace DBC historical index-selection rules with today's holdings or methodology.
Register the curve-factor experiment and cost/roll conventions separately after data qualification.

source_options.status: Optional public positioning source to investigate; it cannot substitute for a commodity futures curve.
source_options.verified_capability: CFTC states disaggregated COT reports first appeared September 4, 2009; a history back to June 13, 2006 was released October 20, 2009.
source_options.critical_trap: The 2006 observation history was not necessarily published with those classifications in 2006. Never date the later backfilled disaggregated series as if it were contemporaneously available.
source_options.availability_contract: Retain original release dates, report observation dates and corrections; audit market identifiers and classification changes. Any earlier study needs an actually published legacy format or begins only after the relevant release existed.

next_version_gates: Do not add any roadmap factor into an experiment after inspecting its outer results.
Archive new sources immutably, register formulas/availability/missingness, and pass prefix/as-of tests.
Use matched pre-2024 eligible dates for comparisons and preserve the 2024+ reserve.
Compare each qualified new family as a separate bounded ablation before combining families.
Keep primary net Sharpe, cash/risk-free convention, execution and transaction-cost assumptions explicit.
